title: A flat convex boundary with two characteristic continuations
completed_component_scope: Smooth flat convex obstacle, exact infinitely reflected polygon and a different gliding continuation for the same constant-coefficient wave characteristic state.
reviewed_arguments: A convergent independently chosen polygon has exact slopes2^-j and endpoints xj=1/j.
The prescribed tangent is the actual angular bisector; all interpolation parameters have a uniform interior margin.
A normalized even compact smooth bump gives a shifted cumulative profile with the exact required mean.
The integral graph matches every endpoint and tangent and every higher derivative at every finite vertex.
Explicit derivative bounds prove genuine smooth flat extension at zero and convexity on the whole line.
Every open chord is strictly inside the permitted domain; full unit velocities satisfy exact specular reflection.
Finite arclength is the actual Hamilton time for the normalized homogeneous constant-coefficient wave symbol.
Both full reflected roots have the same boundary covector restriction, and the double normal root is nondegenerate.
All position and covector errors are superalgebraically small at the accumulating reflection time; the actual generalized derivative and all contact orders are checked.
The full boundary arclength lift solves the constrained Hamilton equation, including every momentum component and flat interval.
Both continuations pass through the identical full state and agree on negative time but differ on every positive reflected interval.
Three complete solutions, twelve finite exact identities,159 formulas,14 displays and ten actually inspected reader captures support the component review.
